entries.0b4c44ce12a0e242: In Japan, against the backdrop of rising new vehicle prices, used vehicle market prices have risen, and it is stated that unit sales in the core commercial vehicle-related business increased, centered on domestic sales. On the other hand, it is also stated that if declines in new vehicle registrations and similar trends progress, there is a risk that securing high-quality used vehicles could become difficult.
entries.360cd1686706536e: The company purchases trucks, dump trucks, and specialty vehicles such as concrete mixer trucks, refrigerated trucks and tank trucks, inspects and maintains them at its own factories, and sells them through 8 bases nationwide.
entries.3931929dbf2a6eed: It has a system that allows the group to handle everything consistently, from purchasing used commercial vehicles to inspection and maintenance at its own factory, specification changes to suit customer requests, sales, rental and leasing, and post-sale maintenance, and it supports customers through eight locations nationwide.

entries.60846c8b4e634da5: Guided by the philosophy of “harmony between people and the environment,” the company aims to become a total support company that uses reusable vehicles and parts to provide high-quality services across the lifecycle of “working vehicles.” In response to the difficulty of securing used vehicles, the company states that it is focusing on its rental and leasing business, aiming to increase sales opportunities by releasing rent-up and lease-up vehicles into the used vehicle market, and that it is also focusing on exports by leveraging the overseas sales network of its subsidiary SUN AUTO Co., Ltd.
entries.626f133244013593: The company is a consolidated company headquartered in Kudamatsu, Yamaguchi Prefecture, and together with three consolidated subsidiaries, operates commercial vehicle-related and transportation-related businesses. As of December 31, 2025, the number of consolidated employees was 97.
entries.64c6812f38b677b1: The business consists of general cargo transportation undertaken by subsidiary Ｔ.Ｌ.Ｇ Co., Ltd. and fuel transportation undertaken by Marushin Unyu Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥848 million.

entries.70dea9182e80cdc8: The company purchases trucks, dump trucks, and specialty vehicles such as concrete mixer trucks, refrigerated trucks and tank trucks, inspects and maintains them at its own factories, and sells them through 8 bases nationwide. Its subsidiary SUN AUTO Co., Ltd. carries out export sales, mainly overseas. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.8c4899893a0ba694: Based on the description of the commercial vehicle-related business in “Description of Business” (inspection and maintenance at its own factory, specification changes, and eight locations nationwide).
entries.8cea7fd29c2812e7: The business centers on the purchase and sale of used commercial vehicles, and also includes rental and leasing centered on refrigerated and freezer trucks and automobile maintenance at designated factories. Vehicles offered for sale are inspected and maintained at the company's own factories, and their specifications can be changed to suit customer requests. Its subsidiary SUN AUTO Co., Ltd. exports and sells used commercial vehicles, vehicle parts and other items, mainly to overseas markets. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥7,125 million.
entries.960a5051c8635490: Leveraging the strength of its designated factories, the company provides after-sales support for the vehicles it sells and, for general customers, services such as vehicle inspections, maintenance, body repair and painting.
